errors.text_span: (Европейски индекс за дигитално развитие на правителството)
errors.evidence: The expansion of the acronym EGDI is not provided in the figure or its caption. The provided expansion is an interpretation and not the standard one (E-Government Development Index).

The description incorrectly maps the years to colors. The legend shows five distinct shades of blue for the years 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, and 2020. The description wrongly claims there are only two colors, 'светлосин' (light blue) and 'тъмно син' (dark blue), and assigns them incorrectly.

errors.text_span: За категорията "Ниско EGDI" стойностите варират от 27 през 2012 г. до 8 през 2020 г.
errors.evidence: This statement oversimplifies the data trend by only mentioning the start and end points. It omits the peak value of 32, which occurred in both 2014 and 2016, giving a misleading impression of a simple decline.

errors.text_span: За категорията "Средно EGDI" стойностите варират от 73 през 2012 г. до 59 през 2020 г.
errors.evidence: This statement oversimplifies the data trend by only mentioning the start and end points. It omits the peak value of 74 in 2014, giving a misleading impression of a simple decline.
The value for the "Високо EGDI" category in the year 2020 is 69, not 65 as stated in the description. The value 65 corresponds to the year 2016 in that same category.
